caption:
Send this to the friend born in January who thinks they know their animal 📅

In Chinese astrology the year doesn't turn on 1 January, and not on Chinese New Year either. It turns at the start of spring, when the sun reaches its spring point: Thursday 4 February 2027, 9:46 am Singapore time. Chinese New Year follows the moon and falls on Saturday 6 February.

Born between 1 January and early February? Your animal may be the year before. Your free chart at skyandseason.com (link in bio) works it out to the minute, and its Calendar shows your own 2027 mark: Good, Steady or Care.
